findings.before: The Thessalonian accusers portray allegiance to Jesus as another king acting against Caesar’s decrees.
findings.after: The Thessalonian accusers say the people act against Caesar’s decrees by proclaiming another king, Jesus.
findings.fix: Keep the accused people as the subject of acting against the decrees rather than ambiguously attributing that action to Jesus.
findings.resolution: Applied in the final primary; all original source/target identities and retained counts remain unchanged.

findings.before: The protection and coastal movement connect, while the destinations differ;
findings.after: The supporters’ sending Paul away after opposition connects the accounts, while the routes and destinations differ;
findings.fix: Compare the actual assisted departures without requiring the retained Caesarea notice itself to establish a coastal route.
findings.resolution: Applied in the final primary; all original source/target identities and retained counts remain unchanged.

findings.before: Isaiah’s assurance to Israel likewise says God is with the servant and strengthens and helps him.
findings.after: Isaiah’s servant-address assurance likewise announces God’s presence and describes His having strengthened, helped and secured the recipient.
findings.fix: Preserve the retained Isaiah text's stated past strengthening/help language rather than silently recasting it as a new future protection promise.
findings.resolution: Applied in the final primary; all original source/target identities and retained counts remain unchanged.

review_notes: All62 complete original sources,55 actual retained target/rationale comparisons and eight deferral assessments were independently read in three complete ordered views of5203,5433 and5037 tokens. Every view remained below its cap and included its expected last source; no truncated passage is credited. Exact repeated target ranges were read at their first displayed occurrence in this ordered scope.

All62 original IDs have one outcome:54 supported sources with55 directed pairs, and eight continued zero-credit deferrals. Target IDs exist uniquely, ranges follow exact original inventory order, directed keys are unique and no target contains its own source.

Athens's interlocutors, philosophical accusations and Paul's own assertions remain distinct. The unidentified poets are not identified as Job, the from-one text is not expanded to one blood, and Deuteronomy32:8 retains angels of God. No Athenian named believer is given an unreported biography.

The Corinth comparisons distinguish Gallio from other officials, accusations from narrator assertions and different visits and durations. No unreported Silas/Timothy Athens itinerary, ethnic Sosthenes-attacker identity, Sosthenes conversion or formal office for Priscilla and Aquila is supplied.

Three rationale precision findings are applied to the final primary: the subject of the Caesar accusation, the actual assisted-departure connection and Isaiah's past strengthening/help wording. All54 supported sources and55 pairs remain; the other15–16 and19 records were preserved.
